dct_description_sm: This dataset contains four CSV files, and one Excel file that combines all data. Data supports research on the impact of a climatic gradient on wild bee communities in boreal forest clear-cuts. Data were collected in 2020 across northern, central, and southern regions of a boreal forest landscape. The dataset includes information on bee captures, site-level diversity metrics, site characteristics, and floral resources.
dct_title_s: Influence of a local bioclimatic gradient on wild bees in boreal forest clearcuts
